config.jade.plugin_atouchofwickedness.ba: Bailiff's player and what it carries
advancements.atouchofwickedness.discover: A Touch of Wickedness
What harm to the harmless costs, and who comes to collect. Learn how each works by meeting it.
Blood on Your Hands
Killing a creature that posed no threat weighs on you. Something keeps the count, and it fades only with time.
Word Gets Around
A villager saw what you killed, and will remember it of you.
Marked
A far bell tolls for you. Your Wickedness is gaining on a Threshold you cannot see.
Overdue
Chains rattle near you. Your Threshold is close.
Forfeit
Footsteps follow you, and the animals run. The Bailiff is coming.
The Bailiff Calls
Your Wickedness reached its Threshold, and the Bailiff came to collect.
Seized
The Bailiff took its due from you.
Owing
The Bailiff left with nothing, so your debt stands. It will return.
Making Amends
A kind act eased your Wickedness.
Sealed
A killed Bailiff leaves its Seals. Something can be made of them.
Keeping Count
A Tally Stick tells you roughly where you stand.
Under Lock
A Strongbox holds what the Bailiff can never seize.
The Bailiff's Bag
A rare bag a Bailiff carried, roomier than any bundle.
emi.atouchofwickedness.info.wickedness: Killing a creature that posed no threat, or beating a defenceless one, adds to your Wickedness: a tamed pet or a baby weighs more, and a mob you kill defending yourself nothing. It is never shown. It fades slowly with time, and kind acts lower it at once. Villagers who see a Wicked kill gossip about the killer, and the village turns colder on them.
emi.atouchofwickedness.info.standing: Your Standing is how close your Wickedness is to your Threshold: Clean, Marked, Overdue or Forfeit. Past Clean you hear a Warning, louder and nearer as you near your Threshold: a far bell when Marked, chains when Overdue, footsteps when Forfeit, when animals flee you too. A Tally Stick reads it.
emi.atouchofwickedness.info.atonement: Kind acts lower your Wickedness at once: breeding two animals, taming one, feeding a hurt pet of yours, curing a zombie villager with a golden apple, or throwing a villager food, only a few gifts a day counting.
emi.atouchofwickedness.info.bailiff: Once your Wickedness reaches your Threshold, a Bailiff comes for your goods, not your life. It robs a container you opened nearby, or else strikes you for a stack from your inventory, never what you hold, or picks up something worth taking lying near it. The dearer a stack, the likelier it is the one taken. It sleeps through the night where it arrives. On Peaceful its blows do no harm but still steal, unless you block them with a shield. Left with nothing, it leaves you owing, and another comes. Your Threshold is drawn anew after each visit, and no other Bailiff comes for you within %s minutes of the last.
emi.atouchofwickedness.info.seal: Left only by a killed Bailiff. Crafts the Tally Stick and the Strongbox, and repairs the Tally Stick at an anvil.
emi.atouchofwickedness.info.tally_stick: Use it to read your Standing, never the number behind it. It lasts %s uses, and a Seal repairs it at an anvil.
emi.atouchofwickedness.info.strongbox: A chest the Bailiff can never seize, however often you open it.
emi.atouchofwickedness.info.bailiffs_bag: Sometimes left by a killed Bailiff. A bundle that holds %s bundles' worth.
